name: Letterboxd Collections
description: Automatically creates and refreshes Jellyfin playlists or collections from a Letterboxd user's public lists and watchlist, on Jellyfin's own scheduled task runner.
overview: Auto-syncs Letterboxd lists/watchlist into native Jellyfin playlists or collections

versions.changelog: Sync to playlists (new default) or collections, plus a manual 'Run sync now' button on the plugin's settings page. Bumped AngleSharp to patch a moderate-severity advisory.
Initial release: auto-discovers Letterboxd lists and watchlist, creates/updates matching Jellyfin collections on Jellyfin's own scheduled task runner.
